final: SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor) AS share_of_all_credits, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor) - (SELECT AVG(actor_share) FROM (SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor) AS actor_share FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id)) AS difference_from_average FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10
